sentences: Last autumn, I volunteered at a Saturday language cafe where neighbours practised everyday conversations.
At the beginning, our coordinator suggest that we let visitors choose their own topics.
She placed two basket of picture cards on a table near the entrance.
I was responsible for explain the activity, but I spoke too fast during the first round.
A visitor asked me repeat the instructions, and I answered her very patient.
Instead of hurry through the next round, I demonstrated one exchange with another volunteer.
The exchange used a simple question which meaning was clear from the picture.
Afterwards, I waited the visitors to choose a card and then invited them to work in pairs.
By lunchtime, several person had asked when the cafe would meet again, which made our coordinator happy.
I returned home with a notebook full of suggestions and promised to brought clearer examples the following week.
